turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on the past simple with -ed?
turns.tutor:
The word yesterday tells us an action is finished. Example: Today I help, but yesterday I helped.
Rule: For a finished action, add -ed to most verbs.
Right: They painted the door last night. Wrong: They paint the door last night.
Your turn: Last Sunday my father ___ (wash) the car. Write the missing word.
